The Hon. Yasmin Catley MP
Minister for Police and Counter-terrorism
GPO Box 5341
SYDNEY NSW 2001
Dear Minister,
TCAC
INDEPENDENT COMMISSION
AGAINST CORRUPTION
NEW SOUTH WALES
Ref: R26/0815
Section 35(1) Report - Law Enforcement and National Security (Assumed Identities)
Act 2010
In compliance with section 35(1) of the Law Enforcement and National Security (Assumed
Identities) Act 2010 (the Act), I hereby provide the following report for the period 2025/2026.
(a) One authority to acquire and use an assumed identity was granted;
(b) No authority to acquire and use an assumed identity was varied;
(c) Two authorities to acquire and use an assumed identity were cancelled;
(d) Assumed identities were used by Commission officers in surveillance operations on
people of interest in Commission investigations and to maintain covert arrangements;
(e) No applications for an authority were refused;
(f) The audit of each authority was undertaken as required by s.37 of the Act and no fraud
or other unlawtul activity was identified by the audit.
Please contact Ms Stephanie Foster on (02) 8281 5873 if you require further information.
Yours sincerely
h Halisteso
-The Hon John Hatzistergos AM
Chief Commissioner
Dated: 9 July 202ęł
